title: Append-only event index after partial writes
prompt: An append-only JSONL event store keeps an index of byte offsets. After an interrupted write, an unterminated trailing record must not become visible, and the index must be rebuildable from complete lines. Fix EventLog in event_log.py: append(event) returns the offset, read_all() returns complete events, and rebuild_index() returns byte offsets of complete records. Use UTF-8 byte offsets and do not append over a partial tail. Run visible tests and validate.
